versions.changelog:
Initial release of CamScanner AIGC Detection.

- Detects if an image was generated by AI models (e.g. Stable Diffusion, Midjourney, DALL·E).
- Returns a JSON result with AI verdict (`ai_check_result`), confidence score, and human-readable explanation.
- Supports clear, user-facing mappings: "not AI-generated", "suspected AI-generated", or "AI-generated".
- Triggers automatically when users ask about AI art or image authenticity, or share an image with relevant queries.
- Results are privacy-conscious; images are processed in real time with no permanent server storage.
